description:
💠 Day 1/15 | Fuzzy Wire Craft | Step by step tutorial | How to make fuzzy wire Flower  #shorts
 
Chenille stems are also known as pipe cleaner or Fuzzy Wire. 
Usually Available in 6mm, 7mm, 8mm thickness.

#tutorial #shorts #chenillestem #pipecleanercrafts #fuzzywireflowers

Complete Tutorial Steps -

Step 1-
Take 3 fuzzy wire;
Cut 2 into half and fold 1 into half.

Step 2- 
Attach the cut wire 
to folded fuzzy wire as shown, 
to give to shape of petal.

Step 3 - 
Similarly make 4 more petals,
attach them all together 
using B-7000 glue

Step 4 - 
Use white fuzzy wire 
and roll it from top 
and insert it from centre 
and secure with glue.

Step 5 - 
Insert flower stem 
and twist remaining part of fussy wire to it

Step 6 -
Use green fuzzy wire 
to make sepal and leaf of flower.

Step 7 -
Secure everything with green tape.

Step 8 - Subscribe / Follow
to see tutorial of next flower.
